title: White-haired Warrior Woman
description: A young woman with long flowing white hair stands in a dynamic combat stance against a dark gray background. She wears a blue and black fantasy outfit consisting of a cropped blue vest, black undershirt, loose dark pants with blue accents, blue boots, and matching blue arm guards and hand wraps, with a dagger sheathed at her waist.
prompt: A young woman with long flowing silver-white hair tied with a blue ribbon, standing in a wide combat stance with one fist raised near her face. She has a serious expression and wears a cropped blue vest with black accents over a dark shirt, loose dark blue pants with a blue sash and silver chain, blue boots, and blue forearm wraps. A dagger is sheathed at her hip. Dramatic studio lighting against a solid dark gray background, realistic digital painting style.
